manual_audits_required.description: Language of Parts: If there are passages in the content that use a different language than the default language of the page, ensure that the language of those passages is identified using the lang attribute.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Use the 'lang' attribute to identify the language of any content that differs from the page's default language.

manual_audits_required.description: Unusual Words: A mechanism for identifying specific definitions of words or phrases used in an unusual or restricted way, including idioms and jargon.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Provide definitions or explanations for unusual words, phrases, idioms, or jargon.

manual_audits_required.description: Abbreviations: A mechanism for identifying the expanded form or meaning of abbreviations.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Provide a way to access the expanded form or meaning of abbreviations.

manual_audits_required.description: Reading Level: When text requires reading ability more advanced than the lower secondary education level after removal of proper names and titles, supplemental content, or a version that does not require reading ability more advanced than the lower secondary education level, is available.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Provide a simplified version of content that requires advanced reading skills.

manual_audits_required.description: Pronunciation: A mechanism is available for identifying specific pronunciation of words where meaning of words, in context, is ambiguous without knowing the pronunciation.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Provide pronunciation guides for words where pronunciation is critical to understanding the meaning.

manual_audits_required.description: Change on Request: Changes of user interface components do not occur automatically unless the user has been advised of the behavior before using the component.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Inform users about any automatic changes to UI components before they interact with them.

manual_audits_required.description: Labels or Instructions: Ensure that labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Provide clear and concise labels or instructions for all input fields.

manual_audits_required.description: Help: Provide context-sensitive help.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Provide context-sensitive help for complex forms or processes.

manual_audits_required.description: Error Prevention (All): For Web pages that cause legal commitments or financial transactions for the user to occur, that modify or delete user-controllable data in data storage systems, or that submit user test responses, at least one of the following is true: Reversible, Checked, Confirmed.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Implement error prevention measures such as reversible actions, data checking, or confirmation steps for critical transactions.

manual_audits_required.description: Name, Role, Value: For all user interface components (including but not limited to form elements, links and components generated by scripts), the name and role can be programmatically determined; states, properties, and values that can be set by the user can be programmatically set; and notification of changes to these items is available to user agents, including assistive technologies.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Ensure that all UI components have programmatically determinable names, roles, and values, and that changes are communicated to assistive technologies.

manual_audits_required.description: Status Messages: Status messages can be programmatically determined through role or properties such that they can be presented to the user by assistive technologies without receiving focus.
manual_audits_required.fix_tip: Use ARIA live regions to communicate status messages to assistive technologies without moving focus.

not_applicable.description: Identify Purpose: The purpose of UI components, icons, and regions can be programmatically determined.
Audio content does not play automatically for more than 3 seconds.
Contrast (Enhanced): Text contrast must meet a ratio of 7:1.
Low or No Background Audio: Audio content with speech has no or very low background noise.
Visual Presentation: Text blocks are easily readable with user-selectable styling and spacing.
Images of Text (No Exception): Images of text are only used for decoration.
Keyboard (No Exception): All functionality is operable through a keyboard without time limits.
Timeouts: Users are warned of any timeout that could result in data loss.
**Focus Not Obscured (Minimum):** Focus indicator is at least partially visible when focused.
**Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced):** Focus indicator is completely visible when focused.
**Focus Appearance (Enhanced):** The focus indicator is clearly visible and meets minimum size and contrast requirements.
**Dragging Movements:** All dragging movements can be operated by a single pointer without dragging.
**Target Size (Minimum):** Target size must be at least 24x24 CSS pixels.
**Consistent Help:** Help mechanisms are provided consistently across a set of web pages.
**Redundant Entry:** Automatically populate information available in a previous step.
**Accessible Authentication (Minimum):** No cognitive function tests (like memorizing patterns) for authentication.
**Accessible Authentication (Enhanced):** Authentication does not rely on object recognition or memorization tests.
